text:
Alex: Quick recap from this morning's perf run — microbatch tuning for streaming chat vs non-stream completions. Short summary: identical mbsize across both modes blows up streaming p99 when KV hit rate falls.
Maria: numbers plz :eyes: 
Alex: paste:
- non-stream (sync) mb=12: p50 20ms p95 70ms p99 115ms thpt 1.0x
- streaming mb=12: p50 24ms p95 160ms p99 480ms thpt 0.92x
- streaming mb=3: p50 28ms p95 95ms p99 170ms thpt 0.72x
Sam: mb=3 helps tail but drops throughput. Was KV hit different?
Alex: yes — kv_hit dropped 90% -> 65% due to short-lived shard evictions under burst. Kernel setup + kv fetch stalls dominated tail.
Dana: So it's kernel selection + KV-miss amplification, not batching alone.
Priya: Do we have traces/stack samples? Any RPC gaps?
Alex: uploaded trace snippet:
```
recv_rpc -> scheduler -> select_kernel("attn-fused")
if kv_miss:
  async_kv_fetch -> kernel_wait -> kernel_exec
stream_send_chunk -> ack -> continue
```
The latency gap is in kernel_wait during kv_fetch.
Maria: Can we make mb heuristic KV-aware? e.g., lower mb for streaming when local_kv_hit < 80%
Sam: I sketched a heuristic: effective_mb = max(2, floor(global_mb * kv_hit_local) - stream_penalty). stream_penalty = 2 for streaming clients with SLO<=300ms.
Alex: That will nudge streaming sessions to smaller mb under KV pressure. Also prefer small-mb-friendly kernels for stream paths.
Dana: Add kernel hint: when mb<=4 and streaming prefer "attn-lite" kernel to reduce handshake cost.
Priya: Risk: too many lite kernels could hurt sync completions if routing is global.
Maria: limit policy to per-queue + per-client SLO tags (only apply for stream=true & slo<=300)
Alex: Experimental plan:
1) KV-aware mb heuristic behind FF
2) Kernel-hint for small-mb streaming
3) Canary A/B with injected low KV hit to stress
4) Metrics: p50/p95/p99, throughput, kv_hit_local, handshake_count, kernel_choice
Sam: I'll implement FF + metrics (ETA: tomorrow). I'll emit mb_effective, kv_hit_local, kernel_choice, handshake_ms
Dana: I'll add perf-bot rollback trigger: if stream p99 > 2x baseline AND handshake_count increases -> rollback
Priya: Also POC client-side KV prefetch for streaming sessions (prefetch on first token for sessions expected >8 tokens)
Maria: Keep mb floor >=2 so we don't remove batching entirely for tiny clients.
Alex: Action items:
- Sam: FF + metrics (tomorrow)
- Dana: perf-bot rollback rule (EOD)
- Priya: prefetch POC (Friday)
- Maria: update canary playbook
perf-bot: Canary deployed to canary-pool-7 at 3612346789 — collecting metrics
Sam: seeing kv_hit_local dip -> mb_effective sliding to 3 -> stream p99 improves after ~45s
Maria: looks promising. Watch overall throughput; may need burst capacity or quotas.
Alex: We'll keep canary small for 24h. If stable, plan rollout and RFC update.
